title: fix(objectql)!: a field's picklist resolves from the package that declares it; the api index keeps one item per package and name
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi92EgaXEnM5vQrniaS8pq3eQ)_

Part of #31678

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Narrowing: yes. (1) D3 (a): a package field whose `picklist` only an environment-authored item holds is served with no options and its values are refused. (2) The general outside-closure case, ruled inside ADR-0150 D3 step 3: a package field whose `picklist` another package holds, with no declared dependency on that package, is refused the same way. First-party count: 0 for both. No `examples/**` app and no platform package declares a picklist (only notes in `examples/app-showcase/src/coverage.ts` mention them). HotCRM is not in this session's repository scope, so it is not measured. D3 (a) is not measurable first-party, because no environment exists there.
Skills-docs: none. The published skills never teach a field that names another package's picklist; `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` mentions picklist only for `fieldPatches`.

This PR is a **draft on purpose**. It must not land until the maintainer rules N1 (a same-artifact sibling with no declared dependency) on #31678. It also waits on R2 #31716 for the core boundary. Two tests are red here on purpose, one for N1 and one for R2: see Acceptance notes.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：字段上的 `picklist` 名称现在按“声明该字段的包”去解析（自己的包 → 已声明依赖的包 + sys → 拒绝），统一走 ADR-0150 的包作用域解析器；api 端点索引改为按（包, 名称）各留一条。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 D3 要求同名元数据按引用方的包解析，不能再靠“先注册先得”或环境里的同名条目。
- 风险与回滚：收窄。包字段引用了只有环境条目持有的列表，或引用了未声明依赖的其他包的列表，会变成无选项、值被拒；启动只告警不失败，启动后安装会被拒。第一方计数为 0。回滚即 revert 本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 中的 `picklistReferrerOf` 与 `picklistReferenceVerdict`，以及 `plugin.ts` 中启动审计的告警分支。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/engine-picklist.test.ts src/plugin-picklist-boot-audit.test.ts`，看 “ADR-0150 D3” 两个 describe 全绿。
- 需要你做的：在 #31678 上裁决 N1（同一发布包内、未声明依赖的兄弟包能否互相解析 picklist）。裁决前本 PR 保持草稿、不合并。

## What changes

**Picklist, by the referrer's package (`@objectstack/objectql`).** Every picklist lookup now calls R's `resolvePackageScopedName` (type `picklist`). There is no second closure walk, no id-prefix reading and no first-registered fallback on any touched path.

- A field's `picklist` resolves with the package that declares that field as the caller. The referrer is the last packaged `own` or `extend` contributor that declares the same `picklist` on that field (`picklistReferrerOf`). A field written only by an environment-authored body (a tenant overlay, an object created in Studio) has no package, so it resolves environment-wide, as before.
- A `picklistExtensions` entry's `extend` resolves caller-less (the epic seat's ruling X on this card). An extension still adds its options to the one list its `extend` names in the environment, whether or not its package depends on that list's package. Extensions are folded onto a field's list only when the caller-less holder is the same holder the field resolved.
- The boot audit (`kernel:ready`) still throws for a reference no holder can satisfy. For an outside-closure refusal whose only candidate is an environment-authored item, it now **warns** and the boot goes on (ruling N2). The read serves that field no options and the validator refuses its values.
- The post-seal install judge (the manifest service) judges each pending field reference with its package as caller, through a registry view that overlays the pending artifact's manifests. That way R reads their declared dependencies. It refuses loudly, carrying R's refusal message, which names every holder. Extension targets are judged caller-less.
- `describeUnresolvedPicklistReferences` appends R's refusal to each line. Its headline is unchanged.

**The api endpoint index, by (package, name) (`@objectstack/metadata`).** `MetadataManager.listForIndex('api')` (the matcher's `listApiItems` and the anonymous-flow-door audit) now keeps one slot per (package, name) instead of one per bare name. A package-less row under a name exactly one package holds is that package's customization, so it keeps sharing that slot (first entry wins, registry before loaders, as before). An environment-only row has its own slot. There is no resolver call there: `@objectstack/metadata` cannot import R (objectql depends on it), and the request side is caller-less. The route grammar and precedence are untouched (they belong to G1 and the router).

### Every by-name reader and the referrer it now passes

| Reader | Referrer package passed |
|:--|:--|
| `SchemaRegistry.resolvePicklistFields` through `finishServedObject` (every served object, from `foldExtendersOntoDefinition` and the no-extenders branch of `foldObjectExtendersOnto`) | the declaring packaged contributor's `packageId` (`picklistReferrerOf`); `null` when only an environment-authored body declares the field |
| `SchemaRegistry.resolvePicklistOptions(name, callerPackageId?)` | the caller's argument; omitted means package-less |
| `SchemaRegistry.findUnresolvedPicklistReferences` / `findEnvironmentHeldPicklistReferences` (boot audit, `plugin.ts` `kernel:ready`) | each packaged contributor's `packageId` |
| `SchemaRegistry.findOrphanPicklistExtensions` (boot audit) | none (caller-less, ruling X) |
| `registerPicklistExtension` / `assertPicklistValuesDistinct` | none (caller-less, ruling X) |
| post-seal install judge (`plugin.ts`, manifest service) | field refs: the pending package's id, with the pending manifests overlaid; extensions: none |
| `protocol-save-door-refusals.ts` (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, save door) | none: a package-less caller per R. Not in this card's surface, so not edited |
| `cli/src/utils/seed-record-values.ts` | none: a package-less caller per R. Not in this card's surface, so not edited |
| `MetadataManager.listForIndex('api')` → `EndpointMatcher` | none: requests are caller-less. The key is now (package, name), not the bare name |

**Not in this PR.**
- Functions: R throws for `function`, which is outside `PACKAGE_SCOPED_TYPES`, and holders live in the engine's function map. That seam goes to R2 (#31716), then a follow-up card.
- Mapping and dataset: no package-referrer reader exists in this card's surface. Their doors (rest `import-mapping.ts`, `analytics-routes.ts`) and service-analytics' cube-name reads resolve as package-less callers per R. There is no code for them here.

That is why the first line says `Part of`, not `Fixes`.

## Tests

New pins. Each one is red on `main` and ablation-verified.

- `packages/objectql/src/engine-picklist.test.ts`, describe `picklist — resolved from the package that writes the reference (ADR-0150 D3)`:
  - D3 (a): an environment-only list, so the field is served no options, the validator refuses, and `findEnvironmentHeldPicklistReferences` names it.
  - Outside the closure: refused, naming `package "com.test.lists"`.
  - CONTROL: with a declared dependency, the list is served.
  - CONTROL: a package-less referrer is served the environment list.
  - An extension extends caller-less with no dependency.
- `packages/objectql/src/plugin-picklist-boot-audit.test.ts`, describe `the picklist boot audit — a list only the environment holds (ADR-0150 D3 (a))`:
  - The boot succeeds and serves no options.
  - A late artifact is refused, naming the environment.
  - CONTROL: with a dependency, it registers.
- `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts`, describe `the endpoint index keeps one slot per (package, name) (ADR-0150 D4)`:
  - Two packages' same-named items are both served.
  - CONTROL: a package-less row shares the holder slot, and the first one wins.
  - CONTROL: an environment-only row is served.

**Forced test edits** (fixtures that relied on outside-closure resolution, which D3 step 3 now refuses):
- `engine-picklist.test.ts`: the `HEALTH` app gains `dependencies: { 'com.test.picklist.core': '^1.0.0' }`.
- `engine-picklist.test.ts`: the load-order test registers its object under `com.test.core` (the list's own package) instead of `com.test.early`.
- `plugin-picklist-boot-audit.test.ts` "boots when the list arrives…": the app gains `dependencies: { 'com.test.boot.lists': '^1.0.0' }`.
- `plugin-picklist-boot-audit.test.ts` "after the boot, an artifact that brings its own list…": `com.test.late` gains the same dependency.

**Red on `main`.** The new pins were run against `main`'s source:
- engine-picklist: two red (`expected [{Gold}] to be undefined`); its three controls pass.
- boot audit: two red (`expected ['technology'] to deeply equal []`, `expected [Function] to throw`); its control passes.
- api index: one red (`expected undefined to be 'b'`); its two controls pass.

**Ablations** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; restored each time, blob equal to HEAD):
1. Drop the referrer (always caller-less): two pins red.
2. Fold the boot's environment-held arm back into the throwing set: one red.
3. Remove the api `byPackage` delegation: one red.

## Acceptance notes

**Red line 3.**
- (a) Phase-1 one-holder suites are green and untouched: `registry-bare-name-one-holder.test.ts`, `-ai-family`, `-flow-family`, `-request-family`, and `package-scoped-resolver.test.ts`. `bare-name-one-holder.ts` and `package-scoped-resolver.ts` are not edited.
- (b) Bare-name behaviour (URL, MCP, SDK) is unchanged for every name with one holder, except the declared narrowings above. A package field whose list its own package or its closure holds is served exactly as before. A package-less caller resolves through R's package-less rule (the environment item first, then the unique holder), and the CONTROL pin shows it is served the same list as on `main`. Api routes answer as before while each api name has one package holder.
- (c) No migration. No key or stored shape changes. ADR-0087 disposition: `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, in the changeset.
- (d) `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, above and in the changeset, with a **BREAKING** banner.

**Held red, pending N1.** `packages/objectql/src/manifest-service-residual-objects.test.ts` › "a residual object whose field names a picklist a BODY declares is served with that list" is red on this head. The residual owner `com.example.acme.release` and the body's package `com.example.acme.service` are siblings in one artifact with no declared dependency, which is exactly N1. Per the seat's instruction it stays red on the draft. If the maintainer rules that siblings resolve each other, R's closure (or this card's referrer) changes and this test goes green. If they rule that a dependency is required, the fixture gets a forced `dependencies` edit like the four above.

**Held red, pending R2 #31716.** `packages/objectql/src/core-boundary.ratchet.test.ts` › "core.ts closure pulls neither metadata-protocol nor plugin/kernel-factory" is red on this head. `registry.ts` is in `core.ts`'s closure and now calls R, and R statically imports `packageDependencyClosure` from `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`. This is a missing seam in R, not something this card can fix, because R is not this card's to edit. The epic seat is taking the root fix in R2 #31716: the resolver core and the closure walk move to core-safe packages, and `resolvePackageScopedName` becomes an adapter over them. This branch merges `main` once R2 lands, and the ratchet goes green with no change here.

**Open questions (seat's call).** New names: `findEnvironmentHeldPicklistReferences`, `picklistReferenceVerdict`, and the `byPackage` option of the private `listForIndex`. Types: `PicklistFieldResolver`, `UnresolvedPicklistReference`, `UnresolvedPicklistExtension`.

## Verification

Head: `62e2f40c44b94169b70965702458e77184a7121d`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: 571 files and 11655 tests pass. 2 are red, both held on purpose (Acceptance notes): the N1 residual test and the core-boundary ratchet.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata test`: 71 files and 984 tests pass.
- `typecheck` for `@objectstack/objectql` and `@objectstack/metadata`: exit 0.
- eslint (`--no-inline-config`, as the root `lint` runs it) on `packages/objectql/src` and `packages/metadata/src`: exit 0.
- Dogfood battery (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, after building the closure): 440 files and 3652 tests pass, 3 files skipped.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 72 derived, 72 run, 0 not measured, 0 unrun.
  - 71 exit 0. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` passed once its pinned commit was fetched into this shallow clone. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` passed after a full `pnpm turbo run build` (122 entry points, 72 packages).
  - `pnpm check:lean-entry-closure` exits 1. It finds `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (and, through it, `@objectstack/lint` and `@objectstack/sdui-parser`) in the `@objectstack/objectql/core` closure. That is the same R seam as the ratchet and is fixed by R2 #31716.
- Red on `main` and the three ablations are listed under Tests.
- The gates and the objectql suite ran on `42bdbe6c`. The metadata suite, the typechecks, the build, eslint and the battery ran on the merge head. The `origin/main` merge touches no file in `packages/objectql` or `packages/metadata`.
